metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Middle Back Pain FOR GOOD
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises to help fix middle back pain at home.

A major cause of middle back (mid-back) pain is a buildup of weakness and tightness in the main muscles that support this area. These muscles include the rhomboids and trapezius.

To fix this, we'll go over easy exercises to help stretch and strengthen these muscles for both quick and long-lasting middle back pain relief.

To get the best results, go through all the exercises and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and quickly fix middle back pain!
